questions.prompt: Какой вариант сочетает совет и сожаление о прошлом с результатом в настоящем?

choices.text: If I were you, I'd clarify the terms; if I had done that earlier, I'd be calmer now.
If I was you, I'd clarify; if I did that, I'd be calmer.
If I were you, I would clarify; if I had done that, I would have been calmer.
If I were you, I'd clarify; if I did that, I'd be calmer.

questions.explanation: Совет строится как *If I were you, I'd...*, а mixed conditional — как *if I had done..., I'd be... now*.

questions.prompt: Какое предложение правильно использует 'if only' для выражения сожаления о прошлом?

choices.text: If only I had taken the job, I wouldn't be unemployed now.
If only I took the job, I wouldn't be unemployed now.
If only I would take the job, I wouldn't be unemployed now.
If only I take the job, I wouldn't be unemployed now.

questions.explanation: Это mixed conditional: *if only + Past Perfect* задаёт прошлое условие, а *would + V1* — настоящее следствие.

questions.prompt: Какое предложение правильно выражает альтернативный сценарий с сожалением о прошлом, где результат относится к настоящему?

choices.text: If I had studied more, I would have been better prepared.
If I had studied more, I would be better prepared now.
If I studied more, I would be better prepared now.
If I had studied more, I would have been better prepared then.

questions.explanation: Для настоящего результата нужен mixed conditional с *would be* и маркером *now*.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант содержит грамматическую ошибку после *If I had known*?

choices.text: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended.
If I had known about the meeting, I would attended.
If I had known about the meeting, I could have attended.
If I had known about the meeting, I might have attended.

questions.explanation: После *would* нельзя ставить V2: для прошлого результата требуется *would have attended*.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант правильно использует 'if I were you' для совета?

choices.text: If I were you, I'd reconsider the decision.
If I am you, I'd reconsider the decision.
If I were you, I would reconsidered the decision.
If I am you, I would reconsider the decision.

questions.explanation: В стандартной модели совета используются *If I were you* и *would + V1*.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант неверно строит настоящее следствие после *If I had done my homework*?

choices.text: If I had done my homework, I would not be stressed now.
If I had done my homework, I would have been stressed now.
If I had done my homework, I would be stressed now.
If I had done my homework, I would be less stressed now.

questions.explanation: В mixed conditional настоящее следствие строится с *would + V1*, а не с *would have been*.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант правильно сочетает совет и альтернативный вывод?

choices.text: If I were you, I'd accept the offer; if I had accepted it, I'd have a better job now.
If I were you, I'd accept the offer; if I accept it, I'd have a better job now.
If I were you, I would accepted the offer; if I had accepted it, I would have a better job now.
If I were you, I'd accept the offer; if I had accepted it, I'd had a better job now.

questions.explanation: Совет использует *would + V1*, а альтернативный нынешний результат — *if + Past Perfect, would + V1*.

questions.prompt: Какое предложение правильно выражает сожаление о прошлом с использованием 'if only'?

choices.text: If only I had practiced more, I would have won the competition.
If only I practiced more, I would have won the competition.
If only I would practice more, I would have won the competition.
If only I practice more, I would have won the competition.

questions.explanation: Конструкция 'if only' требует past perfect в условии. Вариант a правильный, варианты b, c, d используют неправильные времена.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант содержит грамматическую ошибку в результате third conditional?

choices.text: If I had saved money, I would have bought a car.
If I had saved money, I would bought a car.
If I had saved money, I could have bought a car.
If I had saved money, I might have bought a car.

questions.explanation: После *would* нельзя ставить V2; правильная модель — *would have + V3*.

questions.prompt: Какое предложение правильно использует комбинацию условных конструкций для выражения совета и сожаления?

choices.text: If I were you, I'd check the details; if I had checked them earlier, I'd avoid this problem now.
If I were you, I'd check the details; if I checked them earlier, I'd avoid this problem now.
If I were you, I would check the details; if I had checked them earlier, I would have avoid this problem.
If I were you, I'd check the details; if I had checked them earlier, I will avoid this problem.

questions.explanation: Совет использует second conditional, а прошлое условие с нынешним результатом — mixed conditional.
